headword: {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A solar eclipse in which the Moon is too far from Earth to cover the Sun completely, leaving a bright ring of sunlight around its edge.

examples.japanese: {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}は{珍|めずら}しい。
{金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}では{太陽|たいよう}が{指輪|ゆびわ}のように{見|み}える。
examples.english: In an annular eclipse the Sun looks like a ring.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}を{観|み}るために{大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Crowds gathered to watch last year's annular solar eclipse.

notes:
Composed of {金環|きんかん} (golden ring) + {日食|にっしょく} (solar eclipse). The name refers to the ring of sunlight that remains visible around the Moon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe an annular solar eclipse
- {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}が{起|お}こる: an annular solar eclipse occurs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}: total eclipse — the Sun is fully covered
- {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}: partial eclipse — only part of the Sun is hidden
